text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What's with everyone... Every single one of them has absolute dead-serious eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Argh, damn it. I can't sit still.
Phew~... Calm down, calm down...!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Hishi Amaaa!
Show 'em what you're made of, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Do your best! Hang in there, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you guys!
What's this, did you come to cheer me on?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
With my juniors watching over me,
there's no way I can afford to lose now...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Hishi Amazon slowly
raised both hands, when—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I slapped both cheeks with a loud smack to psyche myself up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this!
Every last one of ya, come at me with everything you've got!
